# CLI reference

## `omacell`

```text
A spreadsheet for Omarchy Linux

Usage: omacell [OPTIONS] [FILE]... [COMMAND]

Commands:
  convert    Convert a workbook between `.xlsx`, CSV, `.omc`, ODS, JSON, and PDF
  query      Print a range as json, csv, or markdown
  set        Set a cell or range from formula-bar text
  eval       Evaluate a formula in a workbook
  recalc     Recalculate a workbook
  run        Run a Lua script (WP-20)
  trust      Embedded-script trust store (WP-20)
  fn         Function catalog
  config     Configuration
  theme      Theme inspection and reload
  keys       Keymap / Hyprland conflict check
  setup      Omarchy integration
  commands   List registered commands and JSON schemas
  ipc        Talk to a running instance
  changeset  Changesets on a running instance
  diff       Semantic `.xlsx` diff
  audit      Deterministic audit (WP-19)
  ai         AI provider, card, plans, log, and usage
  agent      Hand off to the Omarchy default agent
  mcp        MCP server (stdio, or `--socket`)

Arguments:
  [FILE]...
          Workbook paths. With no subcommand, opens the graphical UI

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable stdout (and stderr errors)

      --dry-run
          Validate writes without changing files

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Overlay a dotted config key (`appearance.grid_lines=false`). Repeatable

      --config <FILE>
          Explicit config file; replaces `~/.config/omacell/config.toml`

      --theme <FILE>
          Explicit theme `colors.toml`; wins over `OMACELL_THEME`

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress non-error human output

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase log verbosity

      --tui
          Open the terminal UI

      --from-workbook <FILE>
          Workbook whose frozen settings overlay configuration

  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

### `omacell convert`

```text
Convert a workbook between `.xlsx`, CSV, `.omc`, ODS, JSON, and PDF

Usage: convert [OPTIONS] <INPUT> <OUTPUT>

Arguments:
  <INPUT>
          Input path

  <OUTPUT>
          Output path (extension selects format)

Options:
      --json
          Machine-readable stdout (and stderr errors)

      --sheet <SHEET>
          Sheet name

      --dry-run
          Validate writes without changing files

      --range <RANGE>
          A1 range to export

      --plan <FILE>
          Shared WP-08 CSV import plan JSON

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Overlay a dotted config key (`appearance.grid_lines=false`). Repeatable

      --config <FILE>
          Explicit config file; replaces `~/.config/omacell/config.toml`

      --jq <PATH>
          Dotted selector into a JSON array (`.items`)

      --theme <FILE>
          Explicit theme `colors.toml`; wins over `OMACELL_THEME`

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress non-error human output

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase log verbosity

      --from-workbook <FILE>
          Workbook whose frozen settings overlay configuration

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

### `omacell query`

```text
Print a range as json, csv, or markdown

Usage: query [OPTIONS] <BOOK> <RANGE>

Arguments:
  <BOOK>
          Workbook path

  <RANGE>
          A1 range (`Sheet!A1:D20`)

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Output table format

          Possible values:
          - json: JSON array of rows
          - csv:  CSV
          - md:   GitHub-flavored markdown table

          [default: json]

      --json
          Machine-readable stdout (and stderr errors)

      --dry-run
          Validate writes without changing files

      --formulas
          Emit formula-bar text instead of values

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Overlay a dotted config key (`appearance.grid_lines=false`). Repeatable

      --config <FILE>
          Explicit config file; replaces `~/.config/omacell/config.toml`

      --theme <FILE>
          Explicit theme `colors.toml`; wins over `OMACELL_THEME`

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress non-error human output

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase log verbosity

      --from-workbook <FILE>
          Workbook whose frozen settings overlay configuration

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

### `omacell ipc`

```text
Talk to a running instance

Usage: ipc [OPTIONS] <COMMAND> [PAYLOAD]

Arguments:
  <COMMAND>
          Registry command id or control op (`ping`, `theme.reload`)

  [PAYLOAD]
          JSON object arguments

Options:
      --all
          Send to every live owned instance

      --json
          Machine-readable stdout (and stderr errors)

      --dry-run
          Validate writes without changing files

      --quiet
          Suppress per-instance human output

      --set <KEY=VALUE>
          Overlay a dotted config key (`appearance.grid_lines=false`). Repeatable

      --socket <SOCKET>
          Socket path (default: focused instance, then newest live instance)

      --config <FILE>
          Explicit config file; replaces `~/.config/omacell/config.toml`

      --theme <FILE>
          Explicit theme `colors.toml`; wins over `OMACELL_THEME`

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase log verbosity

      --from-workbook <FILE>
          Workbook whose frozen settings overlay configuration

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

      --config <FILE>

      --offset <OFFSET>

          [default: 0]
